g.text: HYBRID v2 MATERIAL SPLIT — WHY WOOD + METAL + A SMALL PRINT BEATS ONE BIG RESIN SLAB
Filament: 1 080 g → 330 g (−69%) · Print hours: ≈34 h → ≈10.5 h · Every node ≤ 186.5 mm (200³ bed)
Stiffness: 6 mm walnut deck + 2 × Ø8 mm rods carry > 15 kg with < 0.2 mm sag · Cost: ≈ ₹2 900 / $35 total
Finish: 320-grit sand + Danish oil on walnut · brushed 6061 rod · matte-black PETG · Cyber-Red #E11D2E accents
Every clamp jaw carries a 2 mm EVA/TPU pad — no screws, no holes, no adhesive ever touches the desk.
Z ≥ 0 everywhere (nothing pokes through the wall) · left Vault Z_max 210 < ULT knuckle Z_min 212 · P1E ↔ P5D DT-30 mate at X = 459
Keyboard garage X 106.5…429.5 inside arches 100…436 · mouse sweep X 460…628 / Z 3…65 clear · knee void X 195…610 clear
Any red flag = the model does not ship. Green run = 7 manifests + 6 scripts + 49 components + 67 exports all pass.
